Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Post customized announcements to your lab

Body.Content:
As a lab admin, you can now post announcements to notify users about recent changes or additions to your lab. For example, you can notify them about a new image, a new VM size becoming available, or a specific lab policy being updated. 

This announcement feature is meant to be used for temporary updates that you can disable after a specific period of time. For more information, go to our team blog.
